name: Maitorieska (Finnish Barley Flatbread)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Preheat oven to 300°C (570°F), or as high as it will go.
Combine milk and salt, and add flour. Mix the ingredients well to make a dough.
Knead into a flat, round bread (about 0.5 cm / ¼ inch thick).
Bake on an oven tray for about 10 minutes or until the surface gets some darker spots. Alternatively, fry it in a pan on the stove or on open fire.
Eat fresh with butter and cold milk.

culture.text: Bread is a staple food of Finland. It is served with almost every meal and many different types are produced domestically.
